mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingredients( ingredients_name, amount, storage_date, expiration_date, custom_date, storage_condition, user_id, status ) VALUES ( #{ingredientsName}, #{amount}, COALESCE(#{storageDate}, CURDATE()), #{expirationDate}, #{customDate}, #{storageCondition}, #{userId}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE ingredients SET ingredients_name = #{request.ingredientsName}, amount = #{request.amount}, storage_date = #{request.storageDate}, expiration_date = #{request.expirationDate}, storage_condition = #{request.storageCondition} WHERE ingredients_id = #{ingredientsId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESTORE')
UPDATE ingredients SET status = 'DISCARDED' WHERE ingredients_id = #{ingredientsId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESTORE')
UPDATE ingredients SET status = 'DISCARDED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND expiration_date < CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ingredients WHERE ingredients_id = #{ingredientsId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESTORE')

SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ingredients WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESTORE') ORDER BY expiration_date ASC, storage_date ASC, ingredients_id ASC

SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ingredients WHERE ingredients_id = #{ingredientsId} AND status = 'DISCARDED'

SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ingredients WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DISCARDED' ORDER BY DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), expiration_date) ASC, storage_date ASC, ingredients_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ingredients SET status = 'RESTORE' WHERE ingredients_id = #{ingredientsId} AND status = 'DISCARDED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ingredients WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DISCARDED' AND expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), expiration_date) > 30
mapper.select: SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ingredients_name ORDER BY storage_date DESC, ingredients_id DESC ) AS rn FROM ingredients WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('CONSUMED', 'DISCARDED') AND ingredients_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ingredientName}, '%') ) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), expiration_date) ASC, storage_date ASC, ingredients_id ASC;

SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ingredients WHERE ingredients_id = #{ingredientsId} AND status = 'CONSUMED'

SELECT ingredients_id AS ingredientsId, ingredients_name AS ingredientsName, amount AS amount, storage_date AS storageDate, expiration_date AS expirationDate, custom_date AS customDate, storage_condition AS storageCondition, user_id AS userId, status AS status FROM ingredients WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CONSUMED'
